description.p: Clipsy remembers what you copy: text, rich text, images and files. Press a shortcut (Super+Shift+V by default) to open the history, search it, and paste any earlier item again.

ul.li: Search, filter by type, and pin favorite items
Keyboard-first: arrows, Enter, Ctrl+1 to 9 for quick paste
Local only: no network, no account, no telemetry

description.p: First version: history, popup, settings and first-run welcome.
